messages:
olivia: Quick follow-up from last RFC — we need a small decision on how we encode release smoothing vs backport policies in rollout metadata. thinking about two fields: `smoothing` (rate/gradual percents) and `compat_backports` (list of older model hashes allowed). Thoughts?

tariq: hmm i worry about exposing hashes in metadata that propagate to clients. can we keep backport list internal to control plane and only expose a boolean `allows_backport` to clients?

maria: +1 for minimizing surface area. but ops needs enough detail to route fallbacks. proposal: keep full list in control plane and add a lightweight `fallback_policy_hint` enum for clients: `none|compatible|best_effort`.

olivia: that maps well. what about smoothing? do we want absolute percentages or windowed ramp definitions? e.g., `{start:10,end:100,duration:24h}` vs `10% -> 100% over 24h` as a string.

sam: prefer structured object for safety and programmatic checks. example: ```smoothing: { initial_percent: 10, target_percent: 100, step_minutes: 30 }``` then router can validate.

tariq: implementation detail: runtime needs to know whether smoothing is enforced centrally or advisory. maybe `smoothing.mode = enforced|advisory` so dedicated customers can opt-out.

maria: also add `max_concurrent` optional int to prevent sudden pressure spikes. that will help Dedicated pools.

olivia: good call. for backport gating, we should support `veto_tags` — small denylist to avoid known-bad variants. keep it as list of stable ids, not freeform text.

sam: ops request: add telemetry hooks — `smoothing.metrics_name` so we wire rollout metrics (errors, latency regressions) to the rollout object.

tariq: security note: control plane-only fields must be prefixed with `_internal_` in the serialized manifest to avoid accidental client reads. e.g., `_internal_backport_hashes`.

maria: that solves exposure. action items: olivia to draft schema with fields: `smoothing` (object), `fallback_policy_hint` (enum), `_internal_backport_hashes` (list), `veto_tags` (list), `max_concurrent` (int), `smoothing.metrics_name` (string), `smoothing.mode` (enum).

olivia: i'll draft and post an example manifest later today. i'll include a migration plan for older rollouts (compat shim that maps previous `rollout_rate` to `smoothing.initial_percent`/`target_percent`).

sam: left a quick comment in the RFC doc about validation rules. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deployment queued for schema-draft -> docs branch (CI 2981).

olivia: thanks — if no objections by EOD i'll merge the schema PR and open a small ops runbook update.
